Title: Ugadja, spending blood, and declaring actions

Messages.Author: ira...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
Hello LSJ,

If Ugadja has 2 blood and declares an action to use his special, then
spends 1 blood on an action modifier, does the action fizzle or does
it still work? That is, do I need to declare how much blood I'm
moving, or do I simply declare "moving up to 2 blood to this Laibon in
my uncontrolled"? I think the action would still work, and I'd move 1
blood to the inactive vamp.

Thanks,
Ira

Name: Ugadja
[LoB:PG2]
Cardtype: Vampire
Clan: Guruhi
Group: 4
Capacity: 10
Discipline: dom for ABO ANI POT PRE
Laibon magaji: Ugadja may move up to 2 blood from himself to a younger
Laibon in your uncontrolled region as a +1 stealth action.

Messages.Author: Chris Berger
Messages.Body:


I might be wrong, but I believe you declare how much blood you are
moving, and then move as much as you can. Thus, if you declare you
are moving 2, and then spend a blood on an action modifier and have
only 1 blood left, you'd still try to move 2, but only 1 blood would
be moved.

Compare to Villein, which says that you must move 2 or more blood, but
it can be used on a vampire with 1 or 0 blood and just moves as much
as it can.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
ira...@gmail.com wrote:
> Hello LSJ,
>
> If Ugadja has 2 blood and declares an action to use his special, then
> spends 1 blood on an action modifier, does the action fizzle or does
> it still work?

Works.

> That is, do I need to declare how much blood I'm
> moving,

Yes.

> or do I simply declare "moving up to 2 blood to this Laibon in
> my uncontrolled"? I think the action would still work, and I'd move 1
> blood to the inactive vamp.

You fully declare it. If it was declared as "Ugadja moves 2 blood to this
uncontrolled vampire", then it when it resolves, you move 2 blood. Like stealing
blood, though, or rearranging pool with Parity Shift, attempting to move more
than there is results in moving all.



Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:


It works on 0 and 1. But if you have 1 blood on a vampire and play
Villein on him, you must move 1 blood. If you have 2 blood, you must
move 2 blood. You can't "cycle" a Villein on Arika with 1 blood
without moving her blood to your pool.
